7fb957e4-a94b-496d-be91-b7d75fad7b21.altTitle: No More Love with the Girls
7fb957e4-a94b-496d-be91-b7d75fad7b21.description: Hero, your average high school boy, has a problem: Shio and Akari, his two female childhood friends, go to the same school as him, and they're way too cute! He's certain they don't see him as more than a friend, though, and would be mortified if they learned how he feels. Meanwhile, the girls have their own secrets... Enjoy a sweet and vexing love triangle as longtime friends struggle to be more honest with each other!

6115931a-d629-4db5-b90e-4f7514459607.title: Nagi no Oitoma
6115931a-d629-4db5-b90e-4f7514459607.description:
Ooshima Nagi is an 28 year old office lady always trying to read the mood and fit in. Berated by her boss, taken advantage of by her colleagues, and betrayed by her boyfriend, Nagi quits her job and severs contact with everyone in her social circle in order to restart her life from scratch. Will Nagi be able to change herself, or will she fall back into her old ways?
___
**Note**: Nominated for the 11th Manga Taishou Awards (2018).  
Nominated for the 12th Manga Taishou Awards (2019).  
Won the 65th Shogakukan Manga Awards (2020).

276decee-1efa-41b1-b87e-bc4950c1a66a.title: Shadow Princess
276decee-1efa-41b1-b87e-bc4950c1a66a.description: After the fall of the Kingdom of Jarthewer, Princess Lisselotte and her maid, Hannah, escape to the Grand Duchy of Ralus, home of the princess’s fiancé, Vincent Ralus. Though Hannah has lost her memory after nearly drowning, she stays strong, enduring Lady Charlotte’s daily abuse in hopes of a better future. But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisselotte for the 10th-anniversary ceremony of the Jarthewer Republic. Returning means certain death both for her and the princess, but if they can pull off the deception, it may be their only chance at freedom. Stuck between the handsome but cold Vincent and his mischievous and buff guard, Diego, can Hannah succeed in her dangerous role?
